story: Wailoa River State Recreation Area is a 131.9-acre park in Hilo on Hawaiȩi Island in Hawaii. It was developed as a buffer zone following the devastating 1960 tsunami. The park features the Wailoa River, which flows from Waiākea Pond to the Pacific Ocean.
matters: The 131.9-acre park is administered by the Hawaiȩi Department of Land and Natural Resources and acts as a green belt and buffer zone to absorb future tsunamis.
name: Wailoa River State Recreation Area
